set.body:
Source: PRD.html sections 3, 7, 8, 16, 18, and 22.

Scope:
- Select and document the Scala 3, JDK, build, package-coordinate, formatting, and test baselines.
- Create the initial module structure for core, CLI, local execution, and testkit.
- Define pure opaque IDs, request/result/freshness/failure ADTs, Payload[A], ResultContract[A], and versioned codec policy.
- Record authority boundaries for scheduler evidence, durable control, live FS2 streams, workload meaning, and typed results.
- Define supported-version and fixture provenance policy before parser implementation.

Acceptance:
- Core domain values compile without Cats Effect or FS2 runtime values in persisted models.
- Golden fixture format and compatibility policy are documented.
- Construction, codec, and reducer skeleton tests run in CI.
- Public design keeps routine operational failures as values and reserves effect failure for cancellation, defects, or unclassified interpreter failure.
set.title: P0: Establish build, domain contracts, and compatibility policy
